question: In the processing and presentation of peptides of extracellular origin intervene (n):
analysis: The processing and presentation of peptides of extracellular origin are primarily associated with the MHC class II pathway. In this pathway, the HLA-DM molecule plays a crucial role in facilitating the exchange of CLIP for antigenic peptides in the MHC class II molecule. The other options listed are more relevant to the MHC class I pathway, which deals with intracellular peptides.
